lead.headline: DTCC's Tokenized Stock Production Launch Marks Wall Street's Point of No Return
lead.tldr: June 2026 is the month traditional finance stopped experimenting with blockchain and began replacing its settlement rails, while crypto-native firms simultaneously raised record capital to compete on tokenized yield and AI infrastructure.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, this month the boundary between TradFi plumbing and on-chain infrastructure dissolved in production, not in theory, and the capital flows now follow that operational reality.

top_signals.title: AI rollup startup Dwelly raises $170m backed by EQT and General Catalyst
top_signals.summary: AI rollup startup Dwelly has raised $170 million in funding. The round was backed by major investors EQT and General Catalyst, with participation from prominent AI founders.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Dwelly's $170M raise from EQT and General Catalyst signals that AI-native infrastructure is commanding infrastructure-grade valuations from non-crypto native capital pools, repricing the entire rollup vertical.

top_signals.title: Citadel Securities Invests $400M in Crypto.com at $20B Valuation
top_signals.summary: Citadel Securities has invested $400 million into Crypto.com, valuing the exchange at $20 billion. The capital is intended to accelerate Crypto.com's expansion into tokenized securities and traditional financial services.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Citadel's $400M at a $20B valuation for Crypto.com represents a structural repricing of exchange equity by a market maker with balance sheet incentives to own distribution, not just trade against it.

top_signals.title: DTCC begins first tokenized stock and Treasury production trades involving JPMorgan, BlackRock and Goldman: WSJ
top_signals.summary: DTCC has commenced the first production trades of tokenized stocks and Treasuries in collaboration with major financial institutions including JPMorgan, BlackRock, and Goldman Sachs. The initiative involves the tokenization of various assets, including Invesco QQQ Trust holdings and SPY shares.
top_signals.why_it_matters: DTCC production trades with JPMorgan, BlackRock and Goldman mean tokenized securities now clear through the same entity that handles $2+ quadrillion annually, eliminating the regulatory arbitrage that protected crypto-native settlement layers.

top_signals.title: Announcing Our Fourth Fund
top_signals.summary: Paradigm has announced the launch of its fourth fund, raising $1.2 billion. The capital is intended to support ambitious builders working at the frontier of technology and Web3.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Paradigm's $1.2B fourth fund, explicitly expanding into AI and robotics, is a direct signal that crypto-native venture firms are underwriting their funds on frontier technology exposure rather than chain-specific returns.

top_signals.title: Morgan Stanley Launches Ether and Solana ETPs with Staking
top_signals.summary: Morgan Stanley Investment Management has expanded its digital asset offerings by launching Ether and Solana exchange-traded products (ETPs). Notably, these products include staking capabilities, marking a significant move by a major traditional financial institution into yield-generating crypto assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Morgan Stanley's staked Ether and Solana ETPs introduce yield-generating crypto products into wealth management channels where advisors face liability for omission, not commission.

top_signals.title: Crypto hacks hit record high in H1 2026 as losses top $1 billion, Blockaid says
top_signals.summary: Crypto hacks reached a record high in the first half of 2026, with total losses exceeding $1 billion. Ethereum and Solana projects were the most targeted, losing $332 million and $326 million respectively.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The $1B+ H1 2026 hack total, with Ethereum and Solana nearly tied in losses, means security costs are becoming a protocol-level tax that must be underwritten into any L1 or L2 valuation model.

top_signals.title: Strategy Raises $544.5M and Buys Back STRC Shares
top_signals.summary: MicroStrategy has increased its US dollar reserves to $3.75 billion by raising $544.5 million through stock sales. The company also executed a $25 million buyback of STRC shares.
top_signals.why_it_matters: MicroStrategy's $544.5M raise and $25M buyback confirms that public market demand for Bitcoin treasury exposure remains inelastic to price, creating a self-reinforcing acquisition vehicle.

top_signals.title: Tokenized equity perps drive RWA trading boom to $470 billion monthly volume
top_signals.summary: Real World Asset (RWA) trading has experienced a massive surge, reaching $470 billion in monthly volume. This growth is primarily driven by the popularity of tokenized equity perpetuals over tokenized commodities.
top_signals.why_it_matters: $470B monthly volume in tokenized equity perps indicates that synthetic RWA instruments are capturing derivatives demand faster than spot tokenization, with implications for which infrastructure layers capture value.

deals.summary: AI rollup startup Dwelly has raised $170 million in funding. The round was backed by major investors EQT and General Catalyst, with participation from prominent AI founders.
Paradigm has announced the launch of its fourth fund, raising $1.2 billion. The capital is intended to support ambitious builders working at the frontier of technology and Web3.
MicroStrategy has increased its US dollar reserves to $3.75 billion by raising $544.5 million through stock sales. The company also executed a $25 million buyback of STRC shares.

Alpaca has raised $135 million to develop tokenized infrastructure specifically designed for AI agents. The funding aims to build a foundation that allows autonomous agents to interact with digital assets and blockchain networks efficiently.
Stripe and Advent have reportedly made a $53 billion offer to acquire PayPal. The bid represents a 28% premium over PayPal's recent closing stock price.
Decentralized AI project Nous Research is reportedly in talks to raise at least $75 million. The funding round is led by Robot Ventures and values the company at $1.5 billion.
Gauntlet, founded by Tarun Chitra, has raised $125 million in a Series C funding round. The investment was provided solely by SBI Holdings to support the growth of DeFi, tokenization, and vaults.
Crypto venture capital firm Paradigm has raised a new fund totaling $1.2 billion. The firm intends to use this capital to expand its investment focus into AI and other frontier technology industries.
Crypto venture capital firm Paradigm has launched its fourth fund with $1.2 billion in capital. The firm is expanding its investment mandate beyond blockchain to include AI and robotics startups.

Securitize, a BlackRock-backed tokenization firm, has gone public via a merger with a special-purpose acquisition company. The company raised $400 million during the process and saw its stock price increase by 3% on its debut.
World Foundation has secured $52.5 million in a funding round led by Pantera Capital. The capital will be used to further expand and develop the World ID infrastructure.

Mirae Asset has completed the acquisition of Korbit, officially becoming the largest shareholder of the South Korean cryptocurrency exchange. This move signals a significant expansion of a major traditional financial institution into the digital asset market.
ORANGE JUICE has raised $40 million to establish a permanent capital firm. The firm intends to acquire businesses while implementing a strategic Bitcoin treasury model.

Miami-based startup Cyclops has raised $20 million in a Series A funding round led by Nava Ventures. The company focuses on enabling payment companies to accelerate settlement processes using stablecoins.

on_the_radar.title: Telegram plans 'largest rollout of a non-custodial crypto wallet in human history'
on_the_radar.summary: Telegram is planning a massive rollout of a non-custodial crypto wallet to its vast user base. The move is seen as a significant effort to onboard a mainstream audience into the cryptocurrency ecosystem.

on_the_radar.title: Trump agrees to ethics provision as crypto bill inches closer to Senate vote
on_the_radar.summary: President Trump has agreed to include ethics provisions in a pending crypto bill, removing a potential hurdle for its passage. This agreement brings the legislation closer to a Senate vote and potential enactment into law.

on_the_radar.title: Bitmine expands Ethereum treasury to 5.78 million ETH, repurchases 5.5 million shares
on_the_radar.summary: Bitmine has significantly increased its Ethereum holdings to 5.78 million ETH. Additionally, the company repurchased 5.5 million shares as part of a larger $4 billion buyback initiative.

on_the_radar.title: Exclusive: Visa launches new platform to provide stablecoin services to more than 200 million merchants
on_the_radar.summary: Visa has launched a new platform enabling banks and fintechs to mint, move, and manage stablecoins. This initiative aims to extend stablecoin services to a network of over 200 million merchants.

on_the_radar.title: BlackRock outlines vision for crypto-TradFi convergence as product pipeline grows
on_the_radar.summary: BlackRock is advancing its strategy to merge traditional finance with crypto through the tokenization of various assets. The firm plans to expand its product pipeline to include tokenized Treasury funds, iShares ETFs, and private markets.

on_the_radar.title: Japan passes crypto overhaul to bring digital assets under financial rules12m, Japan passes crypto overhaul to bring digital assets under financial rulesJapan’s revised Financial Instruments and Exchange Act introduces crypto insider trading rules, tougher penalties and new oversight requirements for crypto businesses.
on_the_radar.summary: Japan has passed a comprehensive overhaul of its Financial Instruments and Exchange Act to integrate digital assets into its formal financial regulatory framework. The new laws introduce strict insider trading rules and increased penalties for crypto businesses to enhance market integrity.

on_the_radar.title: Japan passes key bill recognizing crypto as financial product, lowering tax rate
on_the_radar.summary: Japan has passed a key bill that officially recognizes cryptocurrency as a financial product. This legislative change allows for a separate taxation system, significantly lowering the maximum tax rate from 55% to approximately 20%.

on_the_radar.title: US, UK treasuries to align transatlantic rules on tokenization and stablecoins38m, US, UK treasuries to align transatlantic rules on tokenization and stablecoinsThe two governments issued recommendations on the treatment of digital assets as the US prepares to implement a 2025 law on payment stablecoins.
on_the_radar.summary: The US and UK treasuries are working to align regulatory frameworks for tokenization and stablecoins. This coordination comes as the US prepares to implement new laws regarding payment stablecoins in 2025.

on_the_radar.title: UK lays out tokenized finance roadmap with projected £33 billion annual boost
on_the_radar.summary: The UK government has unveiled a strategic roadmap for tokenized finance, aiming to modernize financial infrastructure. The initiative is projected to provide a £33 billion annual boost to the economy by enabling real-time settlement and asset efficiency.

on_the_radar.title: Japan’s largest security token platform moves nearly $3 billion to Avalanche blockchain
on_the_radar.summary: Progmat, the dominant security token platform in Japan, is migrating nearly $3 billion in assets to the Avalanche blockchain. This move represents a significant expansion of real-world asset (RWA) tokenization on a public blockchain.

on_the_radar.title: Housing bill that includes a CBDC ban passed into law without Trump's signature
on_the_radar.summary: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act has officially become law, incorporating a critical provision that prohibits the Federal Reserve from issuing a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC). The bill passed into law without requiring a signature from President Trump.

on_the_radar.title: USDC issuer Circle wins final approval for US national trust bank charter20m
on_the_radar.summary: Circle, the issuer of the USDC stablecoin, has received final approval for a US national trust bank charter. This regulatory milestone allows the company to operate as a federally chartered bank, enhancing its legitimacy and operational capabilities within the US financial system.

on_the_radar.title: Swift launches blockchain ledger for tokenized deposit pilot with 17 banks
on_the_radar.summary: Swift has launched a blockchain-based ledger to facilitate a pilot program for 24/7 cross-border payments. The initiative involves 17 banks utilizing tokenized deposits to streamline international transfers.

on_the_radar.title: SWIFT launches blockchain ledger with 17-bank tokenized deposit pilot31m, SWIFT launches blockchain ledger with 17-bank tokenized deposit pilotSWIFT launched its new blockchain ledger that will host a tokenized bank deposit pilot for 17 major banks seeking faster cross-border payments.
on_the_radar.summary: SWIFT has launched a new blockchain ledger to facilitate a tokenized deposit pilot involving 17 major banks. The initiative aims to significantly increase the speed and efficiency of cross-border payments.

on_the_radar.title: SEC plans crypto rule changes for exchanges and broker dealers in 2026 regulatory agenda
on_the_radar.summary: The SEC has included plans to implement cryptocurrency rule changes for exchanges and broker-dealers in its 2026 regulatory agenda. This move signals a shift toward establishing a formal regulatory blueprint for digital asset intermediaries.

on_the_radar.title: Multi-trillion-dollar asset manager Vanguard hiring crypto exec to help influence market
on_the_radar.summary: Vanguard, a multi-trillion-dollar asset manager, is hiring a crypto executive to lead its digital asset strategy. The new head of digital assets will focus on personal wealth clients and regulatory engagement.

on_the_radar.title: Ripple secures full MiCA license for crypto services across Europe30m
on_the_radar.summary: Ripple has successfully secured a full MiCA license, allowing it to provide crypto services across the European Union. This regulatory milestone enables the company to expand its operational footprint and offer compliant services in a major global market.

on_the_radar.title: TeraWulf signs 20-year data center lease with Anthropic expected to generate $19 billion in revenue
on_the_radar.summary: TeraWulf has entered into a 20-year data center lease agreement with AI company Anthropic. The deal involves the Justified Data site in Kentucky and is projected to generate $19 billion in revenue.

The DTCC went live this month. Not a pilot. Production trades, tokenized QQQ and SPY, with JPMorgan, BlackRock, Goldman clearing through the same infrastructure that handles $2 quadrillion annually. That is the point of no return for settlement rails, and it rewrites the competitive moat for every crypto-native tokenization play overnight.

We have been underwriting RWA infrastructure on the assumption that regulatory arbitrage in settlement speed would protect margins for years. That assumption is now wrong. When BlackRock's tokenized Treasuries clear through DTCC, the custody and settlement layer becomes a commodity, not a differentiator. The value capture shifts to issuance platforms, distribution, and the yield structures layered on top.

Morgan Stanley's staked Ether and Solana ETPs, arriving the same month, confirm the other side of this trade: TradFi is not adopting DeFi, it is extracting the yield-bearing pieces and wrapping them for wealth management channels where advisors face liability for omission. The product innovation is happening inside bank balance sheets, not on-chain.

What we underwrite now is whether crypto-native firms can compete on distribution cost against Morgan Stanley's 16,000 advisors, or whether they become infrastructure vendors to the same banks they set out to displace. The testable thesis: if Securitize's public debut outperforms on volume metrics next quarter, the issuance platform layer has independent value. If it trades like a tech-enabled service provider to banks, the repricing will be sharp. We are watching the next two earnings cycles for that read.
